Definition: perhaps from G5465 through the idea of reducing the strength; difficult, i.e. dangerous, or (by implication) furious:--fierce, perilous.
BiblicalUsage: Chalepos means fierce, difficult, perilous — the two demoniacs were exceeding fierce, so no man could pass that way, and Paul warns that in the last days perilous times will come.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fierce men and perilous times are the same word, and the same warning: some roads cannot be passed without Christ.
